blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen ( Bi directional Mo tion-text Gen eration), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page .
blocks.zh: 文字到运动生成和运动到文字字幕是人类运动模型化的两个基本任务,两者都以相同的运动-文字对应为基础. 现有的统一方法大多依靠自递式模型,这种模型规定了固定的生成顺序,因此不适合于语言和运动之间的双向依赖,使得早期预测错误随着固定上下文而持续存在,同时降低时间一致性和跨模式一致性. 蒙面离散扩散是通过迭代双向预测来模拟序列的,它提供了一个自然的补救方法. 因此,我们提议采用BiMoGen(双方向 Motion-Text Gen versection),这是双方向运动文本模型化的统一蒙面离散扩散框架. 为了稳定训练,我们设计了脱钩的Uni-和Cross-Modal训练,其中蒙面预训首先在对联的动作文字序列上建立跨模式的函授,之后监督的微调专门用于双向生成的模型. 然而,蒙面传播引入了它自己的错误来源,因为模型是经过清洁地面真实背景培训的,但在推断时却遇到自我产生和可能错误的背景,在蒙面严重的情况下所犯的错误通过后续步骤传播。 我们还引入了世代-智能自我校正,使模型在训练期间暴露在自己的预测中,并在早期采样步骤时应用校正通行证来修正不可信的承诺符. 关于HumanML3D和KIT-ML的广泛实验在这两个任务上都表现出竞争性表现,验证了拟议的两阶段培训和自我校正设计的有效性. 项目网页见https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-motion generation (T2M) and motion-to-text captioning (M2T) are two closely related tasks that both rely on understanding the correspondence between human motion and natural language [ 41 , 6 , 12 , 26 , 13 , 56 , 25 ] . Recent work has therefore pursued unified frameworks that address both tasks within a single model, since jointly modeling the two directions promises stronger cross-modal grounding and a more compact deployment. Most existing approaches build on autoregressive modeling [ 21 , 65 , 52 , 46 , 63 ] , which discretizes motion into tokens, concatenates them with text tokens, and trains a Transformer through next-token prediction [ 65 , 21 , 46 , 28 , 20 ] . Yet the underlying causal backbone imposes a fixed left-to-right generation order and provides no mechanism to revise early prediction errors. Once a token is incorrectly produced, it remains in the prefix conditioning all subsequent steps, and the resulting errors propagate through the sequence and ultimately degrade temporal coherence and motion-text consistency.
blocks.zh: 文字到运动生成(T2M)和运动到文字字幕(M2T)是两个密切相关的任务,两者都依赖于理解人类运动与自然语言之间的对应[41,6,12,26,13,56,25]. 因此,最近的工作力求建立统一的框架,在一个单一模式内处理这两个任务,因为联合制定两个方向的模型将加强跨模式基础和更加紧凑的部署。 大多数现有方法都建立在自递式模型[21,65,52,46,63]的基础上,这种模型将运动曲折成符号,用文字符号来装饰它们,并且通过下一个预测来训练变形器[65,21,46,28,20]. 然而,基本的因果骨干规定了固定的左对右生成顺序,没有为修正早期预测错误提供机制. 一旦一个符号被错误地生成,它仍然停留在前缀条件中所有后续步骤中,由此产生的错误通过序列传播,并最终降解时间一致性和运动文本一致性.

blocks.en: Masked discrete diffusion offers a more principled alternative [ 51 , 30 , 2 , 34 , 4 , 39 , 1 ] . By iteratively predicting masked tokens from bidirectional context, it naturally captures the bidirectional dependencies between text and motion and avoids premature commitments made under limited information. However, applying masked diffusion to unified motion-text modeling raises two fundamental challenges. First, training a single model for both T2M and M2T entangles cross-modal correspondence learning with conditional generation, forcing the model to produce target tokens before reliable motion-text alignment has emerged and destabilizing optimization. Second, the model is trained on corrupted ground-truth context yet must condition on its own earlier predictions at inference, and this train-test misalignment becomes most severe under the high mask ratios encountered in early sampling steps, where committed errors persist and cascade into later predictions.
blocks.zh: 假面分散传播提供了一种更具原则性的备选办法[51、30、2、34、4、39、1]。 通过从双向语境中反复预测蒙面符号,它自然地捕捉到文本与运动之间的双向依赖性,避免了在有限信息下作出的过早承诺. 然而,将蒙面传播用于统一运动文本模型,提出了两个基本挑战。 首先,为T2M和M2T两种模式培训一个单一模式,将交叉模式的函授与有条件的一代学习,迫使该模式在可靠的运动文本对齐出现之前产生目标符号,并破坏优化稳定。 第二,该模型是经过腐败的地面真实背景培训的,但在推论中,它必须取决于自己先前的预测,在早期取样步骤中遇到的高掩码比率下,这种火车测试的错位变得最为严重,因为在这些步骤中,所犯错误持续存在,并逐步形成后来的预测。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose BiMoGen ( Bi directional Mo tion-text Gen eration), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. As shown in Figure 2 , BiMoGen handles both T2M and M2T within a single model through masked token prediction, naturally accommodating the bidirectional dependencies between the two modalities. Recognizing that cross-modal alignment and conditional generation impose fundamentally different learning objectives, we introduce a two-stage strategy named Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training. The first stage performs masked pretraining on paired motion-text sequences to establish robust cross-modal correspondence, while the second stage applies supervised fine-tuning that specializes the model for bidirectional generation. To further close the gap between training and inference, we propose Generation-Aware Self-Correction that explicitly aligns the two regimes. During training, the model learns to recover ground-truth tokens from its own predicted context, while at inference correction passes are applied at early sampling steps to revise unreliable tokens before errors propagate to subsequent steps. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D [ 13 ] and KIT-ML [ 37 ] demonstrate that BiMoGen achieves competitive performance on both T2M generation and M2T captioning.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议BiMoGen(双方向 Motion-text Gen verse),这是双向运动文本模型化的一个统一的蒙面离散扩散框架. 如图2所示,BiMoGen通过蒙面符号预测在单一模型内处理T2M和M2T,自然兼顾两种模式之间的双向依赖关系. 我们认识到,跨模式协调和有条件的生成带来了根本不同的学习目标,因此我们采用了一个称为脱钩的Uni-和跨Modal培训的两阶段战略。 第一阶段对配对的动文序列进行蒙面预训,以建立稳健的跨模式函证,第二阶段则采用专门用于双向生成的模型的有监督的微调. 为了进一步缩小培训和推论之间的差距,我们提议明确协调两个制度的世代-知情自我更正。 在培训期间,该模型学习从自己预测的背景中恢复地面真实迹象,而推论,在早期取样步骤中应用校正证,在错误传播到后续步骤之前修改不可靠的迹象。 HumanML3D[13]和KIT-ML[37]的广泛实验表明,BiMoGen在T2M生成和M2T字幕上都实现了竞争性能.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose BiMoGen, a unified masked discrete diffusion framework that formulates T2M generation and M2T captioning under a shared bidirectional architecture. • We introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction, applied to both training and sampling, to mitigate the train–test misalignment inherent in masked diffusion. • We design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, which comprises masked pretraining and supervised fine-tuning stages to disentangle cross-modal alignment from conditional generation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议BiMoGen,一个统一的蒙面离散扩散框架,在一个共享的双向架构下,制定T2M生成和M2T标题。 我们引入了用于培训和取样的“世代-智能自我校正”,以减少被蒙蔽的传播所固有的列车调整错误。 我们设计了脱钩的Uni-和跨Modal训练,包括蒙面预训和受监督的微调阶段,以便从有条件的一代中分离出跨模式的配合。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Text-to-Motion Generation. Generating 3D human motion from natural language has emerged as a fundamental task with applications in animation, virtual humans, and embodied agents [ 49 , 60 , 48 , 62 , 64 , 40 , 7 , 10 ] . Continuous-diffusion approaches model motion either in raw coordinate space [ 58 , 32 , 33 , 38 ] , as in MDM [ 41 ] , or in a learned latent space for efficiency, as in MLD [ 6 ] . A parallel line of work discretizes motion into tokens via VQ-VAE [ 42 ] and models them with sequence models [ 36 , 20 , 22 ] . T2M-GPT [ 56 ] adopts a GPT-style autoregressive decoder, whereas MoMask [ 12 ] introduces residual quantization with masked generative modeling. Despite the diversity of generative paradigms, these methods are tailored to unidirectional text-to-motion synthesis and provide neither motion-to-text captioning nor a shared formulation that exploits the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion.
blocks.zh: 文本对动生成. 从自然语言中产生3D人类运动,已成为一项基本任务,其应用包括动画,虚拟人类,以及体现的代理人[49,60,48,62,64,40,7,10]. 持续的分散式运动在原坐标空间[58、32、33、38],如MDM[41],或像MLD[6]那样在已学到的潜在效率空间。 一个平行的工作线将运动通过VQ-VAE[42]将运动转化为符号,并以序列模型[36,20,22]进行模型. T2M-GPT[56]采用了GPT式的自动递归解码器,而Momask[12]则采用了带有蒙面基因模型的剩余量化. 尽管基因范式多种多样,但这些方法都适合单向的文本对运动的合成,既不提供运动对文字字幕,也不提供利用语言与运动的双向依存关系的共同配方.

blocks.en: Unified Motion-Text Modeling. Beyond unidirectional synthesis, recent work studies unified models that handle motion generation and captioning within a shared framework [ 50 , 46 , 44 , 5 , 28 , 53 , 47 ] . TM2T [ 14 ] introduces motion tokens and trains separate translators for the two directions. MotionGPT [ 21 ] treats motion as a foreign language and unifies T2M and M2T under an autoregressive Transformer, while MotionGPT3 [ 65 ] extends this paradigm with a lightweight diffusion head to improve motion fidelity. However, the underlying causal backbone still imposes a fixed left-to-right generation order, which is misaligned with the inherently bidirectional dependencies between text and motion. A concurrent work, DiMo [ 59 ] , also adopts masked discrete diffusion for bidirectional motion-text modeling, using an RVQ predictor and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning to enhance motion fidelity and cross-modal alignment. BiMoGen instead focuses on the train-test misalignment and error accumulation of masked diffusion. By introducing generation-aware self-correction during both training and sampling, BiMoGen enables the model to revise unreliable predictions while retaining a simpler single-Transformer design over a single-layer VQ-VAE.
blocks.zh: 统一Motion-Text建模. 除了单向综合之外,最近的工作研究了在共同框架内处理运动产生和标题的统一模型[50、46、44、5、28、53、47]。 TM2T [14] 引入了运动符号,并为两方向分别培训翻译. MotionGPT [21] 将运动视为一种外语,并将T2M和M2T统一在一个自动递归变形器下,而MotionGPT3 [65] 则用轻量级的扩散头来扩展这个范式,以提高运动的忠诚性. 然而,根本的因果主干仍然强制要求固定的左对右生成顺序,这与文本和运动之间固有的双向依赖关系是错的. DiMo[59]也同时采用了双向运动文本模型的蒙面分散式,使用RVQ预测器和加固学习微调,以加强运动忠心度和跨模式对齐。 BiMoGen转而专注于火车测试错误的对齐和蒙面扩散的错误积累. BiMoGen通过在培训和采样过程中引入生成意识自我校正,使模型能够修改不可靠的预测,同时在单层VQ-VAE上保留更简单的单转换器设计.

blocks.en: Masked Discrete Diffusion Models. Masked discrete diffusion generates discrete sequences by iteratively predicting masked tokens with a bidirectional Transformer, offering a nonautoregressive alternative to GPT style decoding [ 9 , 18 , 16 , 11 , 3 , 45 , 24 , 51 ] . D3PM [ 2 ] formalizes diffusion over discrete state spaces, MaskGIT [ 4 ] introduces confidence guided parallel decoding for image synthesis, and recent works such as SEDD [ 30 ] and LLaDA [ 34 ] scale this formulation to language modeling. However, applying masked discrete diffusion to bidirectional motion text modeling is not a direct transfer. Motion and text tokens differ not only in semantics but also in sequence length. Motion sequences usually contain many more tokens than captions, which can make unified masked prediction dominated by motion reconstruction and hinder the learning of reliable cross-modal correspondence. Moreover, long motion targets amplify the mismatch between training and sampling, since early self-generated errors can persist and affect subsequent refinement steps. BiMoGen addresses these issues with decoupled cross-modal pretraining and conditional fine-tuning, together with generation-aware self correction to reduce error accumulation during sampling.

D3PM [2] 将分散在离散状态空间上的形式化,MaskGIT [4] 引入了图像合成所引导的信任平行解码,以及SEDD[30]和LLADA[34] 等近期著作将这种配体规模化为语言模型. 然而,将遮盖的离散扩散应用于双向运动文本模型并不是直接转移. 运动和文字符号不仅在语义上不同,而且在序列长度上也不同. 运动序列通常包含比标题更多的许多符号,这些符号可以做出以运动重建为主的统一蒙面预测,并阻碍学习可靠的跨模式函证. 此外,长期运动目标加剧了培训和取样之间的不匹配,因为早期的自我产生错误可能持续存在,并影响随后的完善步骤。 BiMoGen通过脱钩的跨模式预训和有条件的微调,以及生成意识的自我校正来解决这些问题,以减少采样过程中的错误积累.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present BiMoGen, a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. We first formulate the unified bidirectional motion-text generation task (Sec. 3.1 ), then introduce the decoupled training procedure (Sec. 3.2 ), and finally present generation-aware self-correction for training and sampling (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们介绍了BiMoGen,一个用于双向运动文本建模的统一蒙面离散扩散框架. 我们首先制定统一的双向运动文本生成任务(Sec. 3.1),然后引入脱钩训练程序(Sec. 3.2),最后呈现出一代意识自我校正,用于培训和取样(Sec. 3.3).

blocks.en: 3.2 Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 脱钩的Uni-和跨Modal培训

blocks.en:
Bidirectional motion-text generation ultimately requires the model to produce one modality conditioned on the other, but conditional generation can only succeed once a reliable cross-modal correspondence has been established. Optimizing both objectives jointly forces the model to generate target tokens before alignment has emerged, which destabilizes training.
We therefore introduce Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training (DUCMT): masked pretraining first learns motion-text correspondence over unified sequences, and supervised fine-tuning then specializes the model for the T2M and M2T directions.
blocks.zh:
双向运动文本生成最终需要模型产生一种以另一种条件为条件的模式,但有条件的生成只有在建立了可靠的跨模式通信后才能成功. 优化这两个目标共同迫使该模式在调整之前产生目标符号,这破坏了培训。
因此,我们引入了脱钩Uni-和跨Modal Training(DUCMT):蒙面预训首先在统一序列上学习运动文本通信,监督微调后专门使用T2M和M2T方向的模型.

blocks.en: Masked Pretraining for Motion-Text Correspondence. The first stage jointly models text and motion under the masked prediction objective in Eq. ( 1 ), with the loss denoted ℒ PT \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{PT}} . Each paired sequence is formed by concatenating 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}^{c} and 𝐱 m \mathbf{x}^{m} in either order with equal probability, which prevents the model from relying on a fixed modality order as a positional prior. Both modalities are corrupted by the same forward process, and the model is supervised on all masked positions regardless of modality. This symmetric corruption provides direct token-level supervision to both sides and encourages the Transformer to learn motion-text correspondence.

The condition is kept visible while only the target is corrupted by the forward process, and the masked prediction objective is computed only at masked target positions. blocks.en: Auxiliary Motion-only Supervision. Beyond the two cross-modal directions, we include an auxiliary motion-to-motion (M2M) objective, where motion tokens at randomly sampled positions serve as the condition and the rest as the target. T2M alone provides only weak supervision to motion since each motion sequence is paired with a single caption, whereas M2M offers dense intra-modal supervision that strengthens the motion prior of the unified model.

blocks.en: 3.3 Generation-Aware Self-Correction

blocks.en: Both training stages above supervise p θ p_{\theta} on inputs whose visible positions hold ground-truth tokens, whereas at sampling time these positions are filled by tokens that p θ p_{\theta} predicted in earlier steps. This train-test misalignment between training on ground-truth context and inference on self-generated context is a core limitation of masked diffusion training. Once a token is unmasked during sampling, it remains as fixed context for all subsequent steps, and an error made under high mask ratios propagates rather than gets corrected. We address this issue by augmenting both training and sampling with Generation-Aware Self-Correction (GASC) that supervises and revises p θ p_{\theta} on its own predictions.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate BiMoGen mainly on HumanML3D [ 13 ] , a standard benchmark for bidirectional text and motion generation. HumanML3D contains 14,616 motion sequences from AMASS [ 31 ] and HumanAct12 [ 15 ] , paired with 44,970 textual descriptions. We also report results on KIT-ML [ 37 ] , a smaller benchmark with 3,911 motion sequences and 6,278 textual annotations. For both datasets, we follow the settings and motion representations adopted in prior work [ 21 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们主要在HumanML3D[13]上评价BiMoGen,这是双向文本和运动生成的标准基准. HumanML3D包含14,616个运动序列,分别来自AMASS[31]和HumanAct12[15],配对为44,970个文字描述. 我们还报告KIT-ML[37]的结果,该基准较小,有3 911个运动序列和6 278个文字说明。 对于这两个数据集,我们遵循先前工作中采用的设置和动议陈述[21、6]。

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. We follow the protocol of [ 13 ] using its pretrained motion-text feature extractor. For text-to-motion (T2M) we report Top- k k retrieval accuracy (R@ k k ), Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), Diversity (Div), and MM Dist, the average feature-space distance between paired text and generated motion. For motion-to-text (M2T) we report retrieval accuracy R@1/R@3 against ground-truth captions, together with BLEU-1/4, ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and BERTScore for caption quality [ 43 , 27 , 61 , 35 ] . See Appendix B.1 for metric definitions and computation details.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 我们遵循[13]的协议 使用它的预训运动文字特征提取器。 对于文字对运动(T2M),我们报告Top-k k检索精度(R@ kk),Fréchet Inception距离(FID),多样性(Div),和MM Dist,对齐文本和生成运动之间的平均特征-空间距离. 关于动到文本(M2T),我们对照地面真实字幕报告R@1/R@3的检索精度,同时报告BLEU-1/4、ROUGE-L、CIDER和BERTScore的字幕质量[43、27、61、35]。 关于计量定义和计算细节,见附录B.1。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. The bidirectional Transformer follows the LLaDA backbone [ 34 ] with 20 layers and a hidden size of 1024. Motion tokens come from the single-layer VQ-VAE used in MotionGPT [ 21 , 42 ] , with a temporal downsampling rate of 4. We pretrain for 100 epochs at learning rate 2e-4 and fine-tune for 200 epochs at 8e-5, both with AdamW [ 29 ] . Fine-tuning batches mix T2M, M2T, and the auxiliary M2M objective at an 8:1:1 ratio, with 10% condition dropout for CFG [ 17 ] . The self-correction weight λ \lambda is set to 1. At inference we use 20 sampling steps, CFG scale for T2M set to 4, and self-correction at ℛ = { T / 4 , T / 2 } \mathcal{R}{=}\{T/4,T/2\} . All experiments run on a single NVIDIA H100.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Comparisons on Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation. Table 1 reports the main results on HumanML3D. Because BiMoGen is designed as a unified model for both T2M and M2T, we focus our comparisons on the unified bidirectional setting, while using T2M-Only and separated bidirectional methods only as references. On T2M, BiMoGen achieves the best retrieval performance among unified models, with an R@1 of 0.555 and an R@3 of 0.841. It also maintains competitive motion quality, with an FID of 0.069 and an MM Dist of 2.733. These results show that masked bidirectional prediction improves motion-text alignment over autoregressive unified models such as MotionGPT and MotionGPT3 [ 21 , 65 ] , while still producing realistic motions. DiMo [ 59 ] reports a better FID, which is expected because it uses an RVQ-VAE [ 23 ] as the motion tokenizer together with an additional residual Transformer for motion generation, whereas BiMoGen uses a single-layer VQ-VAE [ 42 ] . Therefore, this comparison reflects a difference in motion tokenizer capacity. On M2T, BiMoGen achieves the highest CIDEr and BERTScore among unified models, reaching 60.2 and 38.5, respectively. This indicates a stronger ability in motion understanding, especially compared with autoregressive unified methods.
blocks.zh: 双向运动-文本生成的比较. 表1报告了HumanML3D的主要结果。 因为BiMoGen被设计为T2M和M2T的统一模型,所以我们把比较的重点放在统一的双向设置上,同时只使用T2M-Only和分离的双向方法作为参考. 在T2M上,BiMoGen在统一型号中实现了最佳的检索性能,R@1为0.555,R@3为0.841. 它还保持有竞争力的运动质量,FID为0.069,MM Dist为2.733。 这些结果显示,蒙面双向预测比MotionGPT和MotionGPT3[21,65]等自递式统一模型改进了运动文本的对齐,同时仍然产生现实的运动. DiMo [59] 报告FID更好,因为使用RVQ-VAE [23]作为运动指示器,加上额外的剩余变形器用于运动生成,而BiMoGen则使用单层VQ-VAE [42]. 因此,这一比较反映了运动指示器容量的不同。 在M2T上,BiMoGen在统一型号中实现了最高的CIDER和BERTScore,分别达到60.2和38.5. 这表明运动理解能力较强,尤其是与自递式统一方法相比.

blocks.en: We additionally validate BiMoGen on KIT-ML in Table 2 , where the trends remain similar to those on HumanML3D. Among unified models, BiMoGen obtains the best MM Dist of 2.763 and the best BERTScore of 40.4. These results suggest that the proposed unified masked modeling scheme remains effective even when the training data are more limited.
blocks.zh: 我们补充验证表2中的KIT-ML上的BiMoGen,其中的趋势仍然与HumanML3D上的趋势相似。 在统一型号中,BiMoGen获得2.763的最佳MM Dist和40.4的最佳BERTScore. 这些结果表明,即使培训数据较为有限,拟议的统一蒙面模型计划仍然有效。

blocks.en: Effect of Training Strategy. Table 3 isolates the contribution of each training stage. PT alone learns useful cross-modal correspondence, but its high FID and weak captioning scores show that correspondence pretraining is not sufficient for bidirectional generation. SFT is therefore necessary for producing valid target sequences. Adding PT before SFT mainly improves alignment and semantic grounding. MM Dist decreases from 3.259 to 3.017, and M2T R@1 increases from 0.474 to 0.547, while the main gain in motion realism appears only after SC. This suggests that PT serves as a better initialization for text and motion grounding, rather than as a complete generation objective.
blocks.zh: 培训战略的效果。 表3列出了每个培训阶段的贡献。 PT单独学习有用的跨模式函授,但其高FID和弱字幕分数显示函授预训不足以双向生成. 因此,SFT对于产生有效的目标序列是必要的. 在SFT之前添加PT主要能改进对齐和语义定位. MM Dist从3.259降至3.017,M2T R@1从0.474增至0.547,而运动现实主义的主要收益只出现在SC之后. 这表明,《防范酷刑法》是文本和运动定位的更好的初始化,而不是完整的一代目标。

blocks.en: The further improvement comes from SC. With the same backbone and inference setup, adding SC to PT and SFT raises T2M R@1 from 0.514 to 0.555, lowers FID from 0.102 to 0.069, and improves M2T CIDEr from 44.0 to 60.2. These gains demonstrate that BiMoGen benefits from learning to revise its own intermediate predictions. Figure 3 shows the same effect in the training dynamics. At low mask ratios, SC mainly accelerates convergence and reaches a similar final accuracy. As the mask ratio increases, the advantage becomes larger and persists throughout training, especially at t ∈ [ 0.75 , 1 ] t\in[0.75,1] . This regime matches the early stage of iterative sampling, where the model predicts from sparse context and then conditions on its previous outputs. Training with SC therefore reduces the mismatch between training on corrupted ground-truth context and inference on self-generated context, leading to more stable generation in both directions. Figure 4 further reports the SFT evaluation over epochs on both T2M and M2T, comparing training with and without SC.
blocks.zh: 进一步的改进来自SC. 使用相同的骨干和推论设置,在PT和SFT中加入SC将T2M R@1从0.514提升到0.555,将FID从0.102降低到0.069,并将M2T CIDER从44.0提升到60.2. 这些成果表明,BiMoGen从学习修改自己的中间预测中获益。 图3显示了培训动态中的同样效果。 在低掩码比下,SC主要加速趋同并达到类似的最终精度. 随着口罩比例的提高,优势越来越大,并在整个训练中持续,特别是在t ∈ [0.75, 1] t\ in [0.75,1]. 这一制度与迭代抽样的早期阶段相匹配,即模型从稀少的上下文中预测,然后对其以往产出附加条件。 因此,与SC进行的培训减少了关于腐败的地面真实背景的培训与关于自我生成背景的推论之间的不匹配,导致双向生成更加稳定。 图4还报告了SFT对T2M和M2T两个时代的评价,比较了与SC和没有SC的培训。

blocks.en: Effectiveness of Self-Correction. Table 5 studies the timing of SC during masked sampling. Compared with Disabled , applying SC at both T / 4 T/4 and T / 2 T/2 improves T2M alignment, increasing R@1 and R@3 to 0.555 and 0.841 and reducing MM Dist from 2.745 to 2.733, while maintaining a competitive FID of 0.069. It also improves M2T R@1, BLEU@4, and CIDEr over Disabled , with a moderate latency increase from 0.55s to 0.67s. Single-step correction at T / 4 T/4 or T / 2 T/2 alone brings less consistent gains, while late correction at 3 ​ T / 4 3T/4 achieves the lowest FID but weakens text-motion alignment, suggesting that late-stage revision mainly adjusts motion statistics rather than improving cross-modal consistency. Applying SC at every step further improves a few captioning metrics but degrades T2M retrieval. We therefore use ℛ = { T / 4 , T / 2 } \mathcal{R}=\{T/4,T/2\} as the default.
blocks.zh: 自我更正的有效性。 表5研究了在隐蔽取样时SC的时间安排。 与Dublic 相比,在T / 4 T/4和T / 2 T/2两个位置应用SC可以改善T2M对齐,将R@1和R@3增加到0.555和0.841,并将MM Dist从2.745减少到2.733,同时保持有竞争力的FID为0.069. 它还改进了M2T R@1、BLEU@4和CIDEr 超越了残疾人,其耐久性从0.55s增加到0.67s。 单在T/4 T/4或T/2 T/2的单步校正带来的收益不太一致,而3 T/4 3T/4的后步校正则实现了最低的FID,但削弱了文本运动的校正,这表明后步校正主要调整运动统计,而不是提高跨模式的一致性. 每一步应用SC都会进一步改进几个标题的度量,但可降解T2M检索. 因此,我们使用 R = {T / 4, T / 2 }\ mathcal{R}=\{T/4, T/2\}}作为默认值 。

blocks.en: Table 6 further analyzes the correction behavior. The modification rate decreases from 31.82% at T / 4 T/4 to 22.38% at T T , indicating that earlier states contain more uncertain committed tokens. The stability of revised tokens remains high between 82.73% and 84.70%, so most revisions agree with the next step prediction. Together with the schedule results, these statistics confirm that SC contributes most at early sampling steps, while denser schedules add latency without further benefit.
blocks.zh: 表6进一步分析了纠正行为. 修改率从T / 4 T/4的31.82%下降到T T的22.38%,表明早先的州都含有更不确定的承诺物. 修改后的标语的稳定性仍然在82.73%至84.70%之间,因此大多数修改都同意下一步的预测. 这些统计数据与时间表结果一起证实,在早期取样阶段,短链氯化石蜡的贡献最大,而更密集的时间表则增加了耐久性,没有进一步的好处。

blocks.en: Computation-Quality Trade-Off. Table 4 analyzes the effect of sampling steps and compares the computational cost with representative baselines. Increasing the number of steps from 5 to 20 steadily improves both generation directions. For T2M, FID decreases from 0.118 to 0.069. For M2T, retrieval accuracy also increases substantially, with BERTScore increasing from 28.9 to 38.5. The setting with 20 steps gives the best overall balance. It attains the strongest T2M retrieval and the best R@3 among the compared bidirectional methods, while using 1.08T FLOPs. This is substantially lower than MotionGPT and DiMo, which require 7.45T FLOPs and 2.56T FLOPs. Since 30 steps brings no consistent gain, we use 20 denoising steps in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 计算-质量贸易-Off. 表4分析采样步骤的影响,并将计算成本与代表性基线进行比较. 将步数从5级稳步提升到20级,稳步改善两代方向. 对于T2M,FID从0.118降至0.069. 就M2T而言,检索精度也大大提高,BERTScore从28.9增加到38.5。 20个步骤的设置提供了最佳的总体平衡。 它在比较的双向方法中实现了最强的T2M检索和最好的R@3,同时使用1.08T FLOP. 这大大低于MotionGPT和DiMo,它们需要7.45T FLOP和2.56T FLOP. 由于30个步骤没有带来一致的收益,我们在主要实验中使用20个去名步骤.

blocks.zh: 表7:HumanML3D上的T2M结果具有不同的运动指示器. VQ-VAE部分跟随ParCo [66],它逐个身体部位对运动进行盘点. VQ-VAE表示全身标注剂 [21].

blocks.en: Effect of Motion Tokenizer. We study the effect of motion tokenizer by replacing the whole-body VQ-VAE with the Part VQ-VAE from ParCo [ 66 ] , which quantizes different body parts with independent codebooks. As shown in Table 7 , this leads to worse performance. We attribute the drop to the increased learning difficulty introduced by part-wise tokenization under masked bidirectional generation. Part VQ-VAE produces multiple fine-grained tokens, and modeling their dependencies with full attention requires the model to learn both temporal dynamics and cross-part coordination simultaneously, which may be challenging under our current model capacity. We exclude RVQ-VAE [ 23 , 12 ] from this controlled comparison, since residual codes mainly model reconstruction refinements over base codes and do not provide standalone motion semantics.

Motion Tokenizer Effect. 我们通过将全身VQ-VAE替换为来自 ParCo [66] 的VQ-VAE 部分来研究运动指示器的作用,它用独立的密码本对不同身体部分进行定量. 如表7所示,这导致业绩恶化。 我们把下降归因于在遮掩的双向一代下,通过部分的象征性化带来的学习难度增加。 部分VQ-VAE产生多个精细纹饰,充分关注其依赖性的建模需要该模型同时学习时间动态和跨部分协调,在我们目前的模型能力下,这可能具有挑战性. 我们把RVQ-VAE [23, 12]排除在这种受控比较之外,因为残余代码主要是模型重建精细于基础代码,不提供独立的运动语义.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented BiMoGen, a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. By formulating both T2M and M2T as iterative masked prediction in a shared motion-text token space, BiMoGen avoids the rigid left-to-right order of autoregressive decoding and enables bidirectional conditioning between language and motion. With DUCMT and GASC, BiMoGen improves cross-modal correspondence and reduces the train-test mismatch caused by self-generated context. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show consistent gains in both directions, with competitive performance among unified bidirectional motion-text models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了BiMoGen, 一个统一的蒙面散射框架 双向运动文本模型。 BiMoGen通过将T2M和M2T同时配制为共享的动作文本符号空间中的迭代蒙面预测,避免了僵硬的左对右顺序的自旋解码,并使得语言和运动之间能够双向调节. 通过DUCMT和GASC,BiMoGen改进了跨模式通信,并减少了自产生上下文引起的列车测试不匹配. HumanML3D和KIT-ML的实验显示双向一致的增益,统一双向运动文本模型之间的竞争性能.

blocks.en: Metrics Definition. We follow the evaluation protocol used in prior text and motion generation work [ 13 , 12 , 14 , 21 , 65 ] . For T2M, we evaluate text and motion alignment, motion realism, and motion diversity. Unless otherwise noted, feature based metrics are computed with the official HumanML3D evaluator [ 13 ] , using motion encoder ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot) and text encoder ψ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \psi(\cdot) . For M2T, we follow prior captioning evaluation [ 14 ] and adopt standard NLP metrics including BLEU [ 35 ] , ROUGE-L [ 27 ] , CIDEr [ 43 ] , and BERTScore [ 61 ] to evaluate the fluency, relevance, and diversity of generated captions. We also report retrieval based R Precision for M2T to measure the alignment between generated texts and the corresponding motions.
blocks.zh: 计量定义。 我们遵循先前文本和运动生成工作中使用的评价协议[13、12、14、21、65]。 对于T2M,我们评价文本和运动对齐,运动现实主义,运动多样性. 除非另有说明,基于特性的衡量标准与官方的HumanML3D评价员[13]一起计算,使用运动编码器___________(_____)\phi(\cdot)和文本编码器______(_____)\psi(\cdot). 对于M2T,我们遵循之前的标题评价[14],并采用标准NLP衡量标准,包括BLEU[35]、ROUGE-L[27]、CIDER[43]和BERTScore[61]来评价生成标题的流利性、相关性和多样性。 我们还报告基于检索的M2T精确度,以衡量生成的文本与相应动议之间的一致。

blocks.en:
Text and motion alignment. R@k measures retrieval accuracy in the shared evaluator space. For each query from one modality, candidates from the other modality are ranked by their evaluator distance, and the score is the fraction of samples whose paired item appears in the top k k results.
MM Dist measures the average distance between paired text and motion embeddings.
blocks.zh:
文字与运动对齐. R@k 测量共享评价空间的检索精度. 对于来自一种模式的每个查询,来自另一种模式的考生按其评价员距离排序,得分是其配对项目出现在最高kk结果中的样本的一小部分.
微调 离间测量成对文本和运动嵌入之间的平均距离.

blocks.en: Motion realism. Fréchet Inception Distance measures the distributional distance between generated motions and ground-truth motions in the feature space.
blocks.zh: 运动现实主义. Fréchet Inception 距离测量特征空间中产生的运动与地面真实运动之间的分布距离.

blocks.en: Motion diversity. Diversity measures the variation among generated motions in the evaluator feature space.
blocks.zh: 运动多样性。 多样性衡量评价空间中产生的运动的变化。

blocks.en: Motion captioning. For M2T, generated descriptions are evaluated against reference descriptions. BLEU and ROUGE-L measure lexical overlap, CIDEr measures consensus with reference captions, and BERTScore measures embedding based semantic similarity. These metrics are used together because a single overlap metric does not fully capture caption quality.
blocks.zh: 移动标题。 对于M2T,生成的描述参照参考描述进行评估. BLEU和ROUGE-L度量语法重叠,CIDER用参考标题衡量共识,BERTScore度量嵌入基于语义的相似性. 这些衡量标准一起使用,因为单一的重叠衡量标准不能完全捕捉标题质量。

The BERT variants are initialized from pretrained checkpoints, whereas BiMoGen is trained from scratch. Despite this difference, BiMoGen remains on par with BERT-Large and outperforms BERT-Base on most T2M metrics, with the best R@1, R@3, Div, and MM Dist. This result suggests that the proposed training strategy does not rely on language pretrained weights and can make effective use of model capacity across different backbone designs.

blocks.en: Effect of classifier-free guidance. Table S2 studies the effect of the CFG scale w w for T2M generation. Increasing w w from 1.0 to 4.0 consistently strengthens motion-text alignment and motion fidelity: R@1/R@3 improve from 0.505/0.795 to 0.551/0.838, FID decreases from 0.323 to 0.070, and MM Dist drops from 3.305 to 2.745. This confirms that guidance is important for masked bidirectional sampling, where the model must progressively select confident tokens under the textual condition. However, further increasing the scale to 5.0 no longer brings additional gains, slightly degrading R@1, R@3, FID, and MM Dist. We therefore set w= 4.0 as the default CFG scale, which provides the best overall trade-off between alignment quality.
blocks.zh: 无分类指导的效果。 表S2研究了CFG尺度w w对T2M生成的影响. 将ww从1.0提高到4.0,持续加强运动文本对齐和运动忠贞度:R@1/R@3从0.505/0.795提高到0.551/0.838,FID从0.323下降到0.070,MM Dist从3.305下降到2.745. 这证实了指导对于遮盖的双向取样十分重要,模型必须在文字条件下逐步选择自信的标志. 然而,将规模进一步提高到5.0不再带来额外收益,略微降低R@1、R@3、FID和MM Dist。 因此,我们将W=4.0设定为默认的CFG比额,该比额在对齐质量之间提供了最佳的总体权衡.

blocks.en: Effect of semi-autoregressive sampling. Following Block Diffusion [ 1 ] , Table S3 compares the standard parallel sampling of BiMoGen with semi-autoregressive sampling. In semi-autoregressive sampling, each block is denoised in parallel, while blocks are generated sequentially. The results show that parallel sampling consistently achieves the best performance across all metrics, suggesting that preserving global bidirectional refinement is more effective than imposing sequential block dependencies. Among the semi-autoregressive variants, smaller blocks perform better, whereas larger blocks progressively degrade both alignment and motion quality.
blocks.zh: 半自动反向取样的效果。 块扩散之后 [1],表S3将BiMoGen的标准平行采样与半自动回转采样进行比较. 在半自动回转式取样中,每个区块平行地去除,而区块则依次生成. 结果表明,平行取样在所有衡量标准中始终取得最佳业绩,这表明,保持全球双向改进比强制实行连续区块依赖性更为有效。 在半自动回转变体中,较小的区块表现较好,而较大的区块则逐渐降低对齐和运动质量。

blocks.en: User Study. We further conduct a user study to assess the perceptual quality of generated motions. We sample 30 text descriptions from the HumanML3D test set and generate motions under the same prompts for all compared methods. We recruit 15 users and present the generated motions in random order. For the comparison with representative text-to-motion baselines, users are asked to select the best result among MotionLCM, MotionGPT, and BiMoGen in terms of motion-text alignment, physical fidelity, and coherence/fluency. For the SC ablation, users compare BiMoGen with and without SC, with an additional “Same” option when no clear preference is observed.

blocks.en: We provide the pseudo-code of sampling with self-correction in Algorithm 1 . Given condition tokens x cond x^{\mathrm{cond}} , BiMoGen initializes the target sequence as fully masked tokens and iteratively refines it through masked sampling. At each step, the model predicts clean target tokens under classifier-free guidance, followed by remasking of low-confidence predictions. Here, Remask ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{Remask}(\cdot) follows the strategy in LlaDA [ 34 ] , which remasks the tokens with the lowest prediction confidence. At selected steps in R R , self-correction is invoked by first completing the current target and then revising the already visible tokens, while the remaining masked tokens are left for later steps.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Limitations. Our method employs a VQ-VAE motion tokenizer to convert continuous human motion into discrete tokens. As a result, generation quality is still partially bounded by the tokenizer’s reconstruction fidelity and codebook expressiveness, especially for subtle or highly detailed motions. Moreover, the current formulation models motion at the sequence level and lacks explicit fine-grained control over individual body parts, such as hands, arms, or legs. Incorporating stronger part-aware tokenizers and more controllable representations is a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制。 我们的方法使用VQ-VAE运动指示器将人类连续运动转换成离散符号. 因此,生成质量仍然部分地受到象征器的重建忠诚度和编码手册表达性的限制,特别是对于微妙或非常详细的动作而言。 此外,目前的配方模型在序列层次上运动,对单个身体部位,如手,手臂,或腿,缺乏明确的精细控制. 纳入更强的部分意识标语和更具可控性的陈述是未来工作的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: Broader impact. This work may benefit motion content creation, animation, virtual agents, and motion retrieval through bidirectional language-motion generation. Since the model produces abstract motions rather than identifiable visual appearances, its direct risk is limited. Still, generated motions may be used in downstream synthetic avatar or animation systems, so responsible use, consent for real motion data, and disclosure of synthetic content should be considered in deployment.
blocks.zh: 更大的影响。 这项工作可能有利于运动内容的创建,动画,虚拟代理,以及通过双向语言动作生成来进行运动检索. 由于模型产生抽象运动而不是可识别的视觉外观,其直接风险是有限的. 然而,生成的运动可能被用于下游合成异形系统或动画系统,因此,在部署时应考虑负责任地使用,同意真实的运动数据,并披露合成内容。
